messages:
samir: kicking off a config-only change in tonight's window (23:00-23:45 PT). objective: reduce multi-tenant noisy-neighboring by tightening per-tenant rate floors and bumping idle timeouts. planned canary 1%.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: deploy_id=deploy-4971200000, type=config-only, target=prod, canary=1%
claudia: oncall here. will watch per-tenant throttles and routing split. please paste diff.
samir: diff below:
```yaml
routing:
  tenant_min_qps: 2        # floor QPS per route to avoid tiny weight churn
  route_balance_policy: latency-first
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  max_batch_size: 48
  window_ms: 10
timeouts:
  head_ms: 1000
  stream_idle_ms: 30000
```
ben: small flag: some partners use long polling; keeping stream_idle at 30s seems right for canary.
samir: launching canary -> 1% targeted to low-traffic cohorts
deploy-bot: canary live: tweak variant receives 1% traffic
obs-bot: canary metrics (7m): p50=41ms, p95=165ms, p99=280ms, errors=0.00%
claudia: seeing tenant foo-co p99 spike to 520ms in a couple traces, no 5xx. looks like tail queuing for large batched requests.
ben: thought: max_batch_size=48 might cause a single huge request to wait for batch fill. propose reduce window_ms->6 for canary only and cap per-request batch wait to 8ms via hotpatch.
samir: agree. pausing ramp. will apply targeted hotpatch to tweak variant. include rollback command in ticket.
deploy-bot: hotpatch command suggested: `/deploy config-only --patch '{"batching":{"window_ms":6,"per_request_wait_ms":8}}' --to prod --variant=tweak --canary 1%`
deploy-bot: hotpatch started: patch_id=patch-4971201001, status=canarying
obs-bot: hotpatch canary metrics (4m): p50=39ms, p95=150ms, p99(foo-co)=210ms, errors=0.00%
claudia: much better on tail. recommend ramp to 20% over 10m. documented rollback: `/deploy rollback deploy-4971200000` or reapply cfg hash cfg-4e7b.
ops-bot: note: if rollback is triggered, run `ops migrate routing --to previous` and notify #oncall.
samir: ramping patch-4971201001 -> 20%
obs-bot: steady at 20% after 12m: p95 down, p99 within +15ms baseline, no error uptick.
ben: pinning config cfg-4e7b to variant v15 for 24h as a safety measure. rollback criteria: any tenant 5xx > 0.4% OR sustained p99 delta +200ms for 5m.
claudia: adding short playbook to deploy ticket: owner=samir, rollback-owner=claudia, steps include deploy rollback and immediate unpin.
samir: release note draft: "Config-only: routing.tenant_min_qps 0->2, batching.max_batch_size 64->48, batching.window_ms 12->10 then hotpatched to 6 for reduced per-request wait; timeouts.head 1200->1000; stream_idle_ms kept at 30s for canary. Pinned cfg-4e7b to v15 for 24h. Change window closed 23:33 PT."
claudia: thanks team. closing thread unless alerts fire. :white_check_mark:
